cards.title: 5 V rail sags to 4.65 V, Jetson needs 4.75 V
cards.body: Found 5 V sags to 4.65 V with every servo stalled (2.73 A). Needs >= 4.75 V, the declared minimum input of Jetson.
cards.fix: Shorten or thicken the wire, cut the pack resistance, or move the servos to their own rail
cards.raw:
VIOLATION topology/rails/rail.5v/brownout
  observed   rail.5v sags to 4.65 V with every servo stalled (2.73 A)
  expected   >= 4.75 V, the declared minimum input of dev.jetson
  action     shorten or thicken the wire, cut the pack resistance, or move the servos to their own rail
cards.figure_note: Numbers not shown: this check can't yet say where they came from.
cards.label: Brownout

cards.title: Pack wire: 9 A fuse on wire good for 7 A
cards.body: Found 9.00 A fuse on 22 AWG wire pack. Needs fuse <= 7.00 A, the safe current for this wire.
cards.fix: Fit a fuse at or below 7.00 A or upsize wire pack
cards.raw:
VIOLATION topology/wires/w.pack/fuse
  observed   9.00 A fuse on 22 AWG wire w.pack
  expected   fuse <= 7.00 A, the safe current for this wire
  owner      you
  source     PowerStream, Wire Gauge and Current Limits (powerstream.com/Wire_Size.htm, 2023-04-18) chassis-wiring column, in air, not bundled; rule of thumb, not NEC; this is the lenient in-air figure
  action     fit a fuse at or below 7.00 A or upsize wire 'w.pack'
cards.figure_note: Numbers not shown: this check can't yet say where they came from.
cards.label: Fuse

cards.title: Reserved boot pin: ESP32 IO12
cards.body: Found dev.esp32 IO12 is reserved: strapping pin, default pull-down: 0 (default) = VDD_SDIO from VDD3P3_RTC (3.3 V); 1 selects 1.8 V flash voltage (can stop a 3.3 V flash from booting) (Espressif ESP32 datasheet Table 3-1). Needs a free pin.
cards.fix: Move the wire to a pin that is not reserved (checked against recorded files, not hardware)
cards.raw:
WARNING topology/wires/w.bus-data
  observed   dev.esp32 IO12 is reserved: strapping pin, default pull-down: 0 (default) = VDD_SDIO from VDD3P3_RTC (3.3 V); 1 selects 1.8 V flash voltage (can stop a 3.3 V flash from booting) (Espressif ESP32 datasheet Table 3-1)
  expected   a free pin
  source     https://docs.espressif.com/projects/esp-dev-kits/en/latest/esp32/esp32-devkitc/user_guide.html (ESP32-DevKitC V4 - ESP32 - esp-dev-kits latest documentation: J2 header table)
  action     move the wire to a pin that is not reserved (checked against recorded files, not hardware)
cards.label: Wire check

cards.title: Wire current: servo feed
cards.body: Found 5.19 A computed draw on 28 AWG in free air (draw mode: nominal). Needs <= 1.40 A, the published safe current for this wire (PowerStream chassis column, rule of thumb). Off by +3.79 A, +271%.
cards.fix: Upsize wire servo feed, shorten/re-route toward free-air, or shed load on its rail
cards.raw:
WARNING topology/wires/w.servo-feed/ampacity
  observed   5.19 A computed draw on 28 AWG in free air (draw mode: nominal)
  expected   <= 1.40 A, the published safe current for this wire (PowerStream chassis column, rule of thumb, wiring in air)
  delta      off by +3.79 A, +271%
  dependent  dev.jetson, dev.servo.elbow, dev.servo.shoulder
  owner      you
  source     PowerStream, Wire Gauge and Current Limits (powerstream.com/Wire_Size.htm, 2023-04-18) chassis-wiring column, in air, not bundled; rule of thumb, not NEC
  action     upsize wire 'w.servo-feed', shorten/re-route toward free-air, or shed load on its rail
cards.figure_note: Numbers not shown: this check can't yet say where they came from.
cards.label: Wire current

drawers.content:
# Two-joint desk arm

- schema_version: 0.7
- id: arm-power

## Rails

| rail | voltage | voltage range | capacity | current limit | fed from | charged by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Battery | 11.1 V | - | 854.7 W | 9 A (enforced by fuse, as declared; Lockwire cannot see that it is fitted) | - | - |
| 5 V | 5 V | - | 27.5 W | - | Battery | - |

## Power tree

Battery · 24.4 Wh, 11.1 V
  - Battery · 11.1 V, up to 854.7 W
    - 5 V converter
      - 5 V · 5 V, up to 27.5 W
        - Servo shoulder · 7.35 W
        - Servo elbow · 7.35 W
        - Jetson · 11.2 W

## Wires

| wire | AWG | run | rail | between |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pack | 22 | in free air | Battery |  |
| Servo feed | 28 | in free air | 5 V |  |
| Bus data |  |  |  | ESP32 to servo shoulder |

## Joints

| name | type | parent | child |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Shoulder | Rotates | Base | Upper arm |
| Elbow | Rotates | Upper arm | Forearm |
| Tip block | Fixed | Forearm | Tip |

## Mass

- Base: 0.3888 kg, derived from its shapes and material (density source: https://www.aalco.co.uk/datasheets/Aluminium-Alloy-6061-T6-Extrusions_145.ashx (Aalco datasheet, Aluminium Alloy - Commercial Alloy - 6061 - T6 Extrusions (HTML page; no revision shown; distributor datasheet): "Density 2.70 g/cm³"), read 2026-11-13)
- Upper arm: 0.0324 kg, derived from its shapes and material (density source: https://www.aalco.co.uk/datasheets/Aluminium-Alloy-6061-T6-Extrusions_145.ashx (Aalco datasheet, Aluminium Alloy - Commercial Alloy - 6061 - T6 Extrusions (HTML page; no revision shown; distributor datasheet): "Density 2.70 g/cm³"), read 2026-11-13)
- Forearm: 0.027 kg, derived from its shapes and material (density source: https://www.aalco.co.uk/datasheets/Aluminium-Alloy-6061-T6-Extrusions_145.ashx (Aalco datasheet, Aluminium Alloy - Commercial Alloy - 6061 - T6 Extrusions (HTML page; no revision shown; distributor datasheet): "Density 2.70 g/cm³"), read 2026-11-13)
